comparator.name: International Bachelor Communication and Media
comparator.route: Communication, Culture and Society focus area
comparator.sourceNotes: The official three-year, 180-EC English-taught programme combines communication and media theory, social-science research, digital-content practice, focus-area choices, an internship, exchange or minor space, ethics and a bachelor thesis. From year 2 students choose focus areas. Communication, Culture and Society is selected neutrally because it most broadly continues the generic programme identity.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest curriculum integrates communication, culture, society, media and digital technologies, and it also absorbs the Media and Entertainment and New Media Technologies interests. Political/international communication and organisational/business communication remain coherent official focus directions that UCR can represent with materially distinct curricula. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.
